name: IM-1
payload: 1900 kg lander (Nova-C Odysseus); six NASA payloads
first: A commercial lander on the Moon: it landed tipped over and still operated
description: IM-1 was Intuitive Machines' first Moon mission, flown for NASA's Commercial Lunar Payload Services programme with six NASA payloads. Its Nova-C lander, named Odysseus, launched on a Falcon 9 on 2024-02-15, entered lunar orbit on 2024-02-21 and landed on 2024-02-22 at 23:23:53 UTC near the crater Malapert A. It landed and operated, but came to rest tipped over, at about 30 degrees. It kept working until it lost power as the lunar night began on 2024-02-29.

events.label: LANDING
events.note: Lands near Malapert A on 2024-02-22 and comes to rest tipped over.
